title: OpenAI patch operation function adapter versus tagged edit on order cancellation v2
hypothesis: Replacing tagged-range edit with an apply_patch function carrying the OpenAI operation payload and its contextual multi-hunk diff interface reduces end-to-end cancellation implementation time while retaining independent correctness. This tests the complete editing interface, including necessary instructions and SDK parser overhead; it does not isolate model training.
falsified_if: Any correctness or activation gate fails, or coding latency improves by less than 10%, or estimated coding cost regresses by more than 20%. A failed gate drops this implementation; a passing screen buys fresh broader validation only.
local_evidence: The v2 baseline cell-0001 in evals/results/order-cancellation-v2-20260918-v1 has 33 tool operations, 9 model calls, 12 edit calls, 173137ms, and no failed edits. Matching raw transcript.log LLM CALL #4 and captured provider requests show tagged endpoint arguments (e.g. call_vMy3Lg3TIqCMPbfNx6QnY9QT on orders/models.py, start/end line 11). Cells0003/0004 independently pass with 34/37 tools and 13/10 edits. This is an interface-efficiency hypothesis, not a claim that these successful edits were wasteful. Those eval-local logs are the matching raw records; /tmp/lca/logs contains interactive sessions, not these isolated workers. Official native contract: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/tools-apply-patch ; pure V4A parser vendored unchanged from openai-agents 0.22.3. Repair registration: native-tool screen v1 stopped on the very first simple control because the Codex endpoint returned HTTP400 Unsupported tool type: apply_patch. Preserve campaign-v1/frozen-source-v1 and failed-attempt-v1.json under /home/tim/.local/state/lca/research/openai-patch-order-20260918. That 3.819s worker attempt has no reported usage and must not be counted as a zero-cost model success. Its empty-usage metrics crash is fixed and regression-tested. No coding runs were launched.
deterministic_outcomes: exact function schema and prompt transformation on every actual outgoing request
OpenAI operation payload and actual tool-result content preserved through ordinary function-call replay
existing source changed through assigned interface; no source write or shell mutation bypass
efficiency_outcomes: input/output/cache tokens and standard-equivalent API cost for every attempt
changed source files and lines, added test lines
parser runtime included in elapsed time
decision_rule: Seed 91804; exactly four cells, two arms x simple_prompt and multifile_order_cancellation v2, one run each, randomized adjacent-pair arm order. Astra/high normal history, current prompt with only four edit instructions substituted in treatment, same tagged read/grep and unchanged write/run/job tools, local_only in both. A function named apply_patch replaces only the edit function declaration. Its JSON arguments mirror OpenAI native operation objects: type=create_file/update_file/delete_file, path, and optional diff; no freeform Begin Patch wrapper. This compatibility adapter is not the unavailable native API transport. The description necessarily documents V4A hunks. LCA syntax checks retained. Both arms use the existing function-call protocol; rejected native history plumbing is removed. Freeze engine/source/fixture/grader content before calls and copy source/evidence outside task workspaces. Offline tests must pass first, including known-good and deliberately broken grader artifacts and native protocol/parser negative tests. Maximum four launches, $6 standard-equivalent between-run cost threshold (one-run overshoot possible), 1500 active seconds, existing 900s coding timeout. Stop on task/activation/protocol failure; preserve failed attempts and resource usage. No shell commands beyond the documented full unittest command (optional -B), no writes outside new tests/test_* files; independently audit raw commands. Advance only if every cell passes correctness/activation, no unavailable usage, coding elapsed_ms <=90% of fresh control and estimated coding cost <=120% of control; simple control must stay tool-free. Otherwise drop this implementation and archive it externally. Never adopt a default from this four-cell screen; no broad editing-quality or model-training claim. This is repair v2, a fresh four-cell screen; prior v1 has one unpriced failed transport attempt and 3.819s worker time retained separately. Any further repair requires another registration, with all prior attempts retained.
